content.short: Nillion is a decentralized network for blind computation and secure storage using privacy-enhancing technologies.
content.description:
Nillion is a revolutionary decentralized network designed for secure computation and storage, utilizing advanced Privacy-Enhancing Technologies (PETs) like Multi-Party Computation (MPC). Unlike traditional blockchains, Nillion focuses on "Blind Computation," allowing the network to process encrypted data without ever decrypting it. This ensures that sensitive information remains completely private while still enabling complex processing and storage across a globally distributed network.

Designed for high-value data and privacy-centric applications, Nillion provides a foundational layer for decentralized identity, AI, and secure communication. The network is powered by the NIL token and operates independently of traditional blockchain consensus for its core processing, achieving unparalleled levels of data security and scalability. Through its commitment to decentralizing trust for high-value information, Nillion is empowering developers to build a more secure and private digital future where data ownership is a core utility.
